1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; __a fan; and an air inlet opening positioned to allow air to flow into the housing and through the pad__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

3. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad__, and wherein the housing is configured to be recessed within the wall between the studs__.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __positioned to discharge cooled air into an interior space__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable to provide access to internal components of the cooling system__.

12. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __and the housing is sized to fit between standard wall studs without compromising structural integrity__.

14. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __configured to secure the housing between wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting__ within a structure wall, __an evaporative cooling assembly disposed within the housing for__ evaporatively cooling an indoor area.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is configured for placement__ between wall studs spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

19. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for enclosing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
